description.zh: InstructionX_UIKit 组件橱窗：以导航树分页演示设计令牌、13 个布局预设、58 个组件、属性/自绘动画、原生图表与蓝图节点图，每页附最小用法示例，是插件开发的 UI 参考。
description.en: InstructionX_UIKit component showcase: a navigation-tree tour of design tokens, 13 layout presets, 58 components, property/painted animations, the native chart engine and the blueprint node graph. Each page includes a minimal usage example, serving as the UI reference for plugin development.
